'''Carl Mike Hardy Yoda Smack''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] as '''Yoda Smack'''. [[Carl Mike Hardy]] posted it in 1999.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Carl Mike Hardy]]
* '''Published:''' 1999 (Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Yoda Smack
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE MWYHL Hardy LS 1999 Red32.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

This is a deck I've heard about through various channels. So, I figured I'd keep you informed by posting a variant of it here. Essentially, it uses Mind What You Have Learned to help get Jedi Test 1 (Great Warrior) in effect as soon as possible. Then it attacks you with EPP Main Characters and high power starships. With MWYHL in place, it is difficult for the Dark Side to use S,A,C. Also, with Yoda at his Hut, the Dark Side's ability to cause attrition is reduced by 2. Finally, Boshek trained to be a Great Warrior cancels all of the Dark's Force drain bonuses... This cripples Operatives, and ISB strategies. The use of Main characters (EPP's and the like) and tough starships (Millenium Falcon, Spiral), the Light Side can, essetnially, "bring the smack" to the Dark Side. Things to be aware of when playing this deck are: * MWYHL makes it hard for the Dark Side to draw Sense and Alter. The same goes for you. Yoda does make it easier... But, not by much. Be careful that you might not be able to stop some of his strategies. * Early and heavy Force loss (Visage from a Hunt Deck, Early Force drains from Kashyyyk, ect), could cause you to lose too many important cards too early. * There are now easier ways for the Dark Side to get to Dagobah... He may exact a heavy beating on the Jedi Master and his apprentice.
